title: Unit – 1 : Session – 2 : SLO – 1  |  Operating System Functions — Fill the Clues
sections: 1. The OS acts as an INTERFACE between the user and computer hardware.
2. One of the OS's key functions is EFFICIENT (resource) management of CPU, memory, and I/O devices.
3. MEMORY management involves allocation and deallocation of RAM.
4. File system organization is part of STORAGE (file) management.
5. The OS helps prevent UNAUTHORIZED access to data.
6. The OS also handles PROCESS scheduling and synchronization.
Arranging the letters from each cell gives the sentence:
"THE OPERATING SYSTEM MANAGES THE COMPUTER'S HARDWARE AND SOFTWARE RESOURCES."
